strengths: All integer disparities with complete bilateral image/CAD support are evaluated without SGBM seed, prior disparity, map, pose, GT or future input to CensusStereo.
48 strict ordinal bits and nine exact integer Hamming sums agree with an independent brute-force oracle; int16 maximum cost 432 cannot overflow; uniqueness products use int32.
Independent reverse winner is computed from the reindexed symmetric correspondence costs with its own uniqueness and subpixel fit; final LR check compares positive disparity magnitudes.
Native camera optical rotation gives v_right=v_left-focal*baseline/Z. CCW rotation gives x_right=x_left-d and inverse rotation restores native depth/confidence.
Static bilateral CAD support erodes nine-by-nine footprints, excluding every Census-plus-aggregation input from masked or padded pixels. Dynamic CAD remains in inherited downstream projection.
Five group config/driver definitions use the .4m forward, .6m baseline rig; H retains repeated exposure grid, E0/E1/B54/C54 retain viewpoint confirmation grid.

Generation uses archived native registration and measured joints, independently replays baseline packet/surface/map arrays with exact equality assertions, inserts candidate surfaces at acquisition time, and seals before separate GT scorer.

Scorer code implements all seven frozen gate families for every group; candidate depth error is explicitly conditional, full-image coverage and nohit count are reported, and all-group source_pass is conjunction.
